subject: Marketplace gating by region + instance-family selection for co-sell
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace gating by region + instance-family selection for co-sell

Team —

Acme is moving fast and procurement wants clear guidance on what we will list in each cloud & which instance/VM families we will recommend for co-sell certification. They want a minimal SOW-friendly SKU set for the US, with the option to expand to EU later.

Immediate asks:
- Review attached instance_family_mapping.xlsx and flag any redlines for AWS/Azure/GCP (SKU granularity or family exclusions).
- Decide whether we gate Azure on Dv5/Dv4 vs Ev4 (memory-optimized) for initial listing.
- Confirm if we ship a single multi-cloud SKU (managed) or per-cloud SKUs for marketplace listing. Acme prefers single SKU but co-sell play may benefit from per-cloud items.

Goal: Agree on a final list by EOD Thursday so Marketplace/Legal can prep listings and pricing.

Attachments: instance_family_mapping.xlsx (mapping + proposed VM family picks)

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@microsoft.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace gating by region + instance-family selection for co-sell

Sean —

Thanks for the summary and the spreadsheet. Quick notes after a skim:
- I agree with a single "managed" SKU for self-serve commerce, but we should create per-cloud offer records in the marketplace (same backend SKU, different listing pages). That gives Acme the single-SKU experience while preserving co-sell routing.
- For Azure, prioritize Dv5 for general purpose and Ev4 for memory-heavy inference. Avoid B-series for initial listing — bursty instances will make latency unpredictable.
- On AWS, prefer m7 and r7 family variants; only include m6g/r6g if we can certify Graviton quantization performance in 2 weeks.
- For GCP, pick N2 and N2D for launch; leave A2 (accelerator VMs) as a follow-up because accelerator SKU packaging will complicate pricing tiers.

I'll loop Luca since Microsoft marketplace has a co-sell checklist that impacts supported instance families (they require validated images on certain VM series). Luca — can you confirm whether Dv5 + Ev4 listings meet co-sell health checks?

If we can get confirmations from cloud partners by Wednesday, we should be able to lock listings & pricing Thursday EOD.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@amazon.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Feb 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace gating by region + instance-family selection for co-sell

Sean / Marissa —

Appreciate the heads-up. Quick answers from AWS Marketplace side:
- AWS co-sell prefers m7/r7 series for best cross-account throughput; Graviton variants are OK but will require the performance report and an AMI that passes compliance checks. If you want Graviton on the initial listing, submit the perf artifact by EOD Friday.
- Regional gating: we can list in us-east-1 and us-west-2 initially; EU listings require additional tax & banking paperwork which typically adds 2–3 weeks.
- For compliance, send your SOC2 summary and an image manifest for the AMI (if using AMIs). We can accept a shared S3 location for artifacts.

I've cc'd our co-sell specialist (will follow up separately with the co-sell onboarding checklist).

Best,
Jane Doe
AWS Marketplace Partnerships
jane.doe@amazon.com

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Feb 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace gating by region + instance-family selection for co-sell

Team —

I pulled performance data against our internal benchmarks and annotated the spreadsheet. TL;DR recommendations:

- AWS: initial listing to include m7a (x86) and r7a (memory heavy). Graviton (m7g/r7g) should be a parallel variant, "beta" label on listing until we have 2-week perf cert.
- Azure: publish Dv5 as primary; Ev4 as optional for enterprise SKUs (add note: require larger memory allocation in billing mapping). Skip Fs and B families.
- GCP: N2 standard for cost-sensitive workloads; N2D for higher throughput. A2 (GPU) listing to be a separate SKU that references GPU add-on pricing.

SKU model: create one canonical backend SKU per offer with three marketplace offers (aws, azure, gcp). This keeps billing simple and reduces reconciliation friction for Acme. Marketplaces will display cloud-specific instance families in the listing details.

Open items for decision:
1) Do we require region-by-region image validation (us-east-1/us-west-2 only for initial release)? My preference: yes for AWS; Azure/GCP we can rely on marketplace images with region replication.
2) Pricing tiers: charge a baseline token/unit across clouds and publish a cloud-variance multiplier (e.g., 1.0 for GCP, 1.03 for AWS, 1.02 for Azure) to reflect marketplace fees. Legal needs final multipliers by Thursday.

I attached a short notes sheet inside instance_family_mapping.xlsx (see tab "ops_notes").

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Product Manager, Marketplace & GTM
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Jane Doe <jane.doe@amazon.com>, Luca Moretti <luca.moretti@microsoft.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@gcp-partners.com>, Procurement - Acme Dataworks <procurement@acmedataworks.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Feb 2027 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace gating by region + instance-family selection for co-sell

Thanks, all — alignment check and next steps below.

Final decisions (agreed):
- Listing model: Single canonical backend SKU with per-cloud marketplace offers (aws / azure / gcp). This gives Acme the single-SKU purchase flow while enabling partner co-sell routing.
- AWS launch: us-east-1 + us-west-2, include m7 (x86) + r7 (memory). Graviton variants will be published as "experimental" variants once perf artifacts uploaded (deadline: EOD Friday).
- Azure launch: Dv5 primary, Ev4 optional enterprise SKU (no B-series). Luca confirmed Dv5/Ev4 satisfy the co-sell checklist pre-reqs for images.
- GCP launch: N2 / N2D initial; A2 GPU as separate add-on SKU in next sprint.
- Region plan: US initial only; EU expansion after tax/banking paperwork (target +3 weeks).
- Pricing approach: canonical unit price with cloud multipliers: AWS 1.03, Azure 1.02, GCP 1.00 (Legal to sign off by Thursday EOD).

Action items:
- Karthik: finalize the ops_notes tab and confirm AMI/image manifests for AWS by Friday EOD.
- Marissa: coordinate co-sell onboarding with cloud partners and confirm Microsoft checklist items (Luca to confirm any outstanding fields).
- Priyom: draft the marketplace offer descriptions (short + long copy) and pass to Legal for multipliers.
- Jane / cloud partners: confirm any additional marketplace artifact requirements (Jane said SOC2 summary + AMI manifest for AWS).

Attached: acme_pricing_sheet_v1.pdf (quote for canonical SKU + multipliers).

I'll follow up with Legal and Marketplace ops once artifacts arrive.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: acme_pricing_sheet_v1.pdf
